CORE FEATURES

Core Security Mechanisms

From request initiation to execution completion, Vigils implants security controls at every stage

POLICY

Policy Engine

Effect-based deterministic rule matching with fail-closed ordering: Deny > Approve > Allow

AUDIT

Audit Chain

SHA-256 hash chain storage. Every record is tamper-proof with FTS5 full-text search

LEASE

Credential Lease

Real secrets never enter model context. Injected via short-term lease, burned after use

APPROVAL

Approval Queue

High-risk operations enter human approval with Once / ThisSession / ForTool scopes

SANDBOX

Sandbox Execution

Wasmtime + env_clear + network deny. Least-privilege execution of Agent requests

REDACTION

PII Redaction

Hard rules + ONNX model dual-layer scanning for 8 types of sensitive information

BROWSER

Browser Extension

Chrome MV3 real-time interception of Paste and Submit. Prevents sensitive info entering LLM context

GATEWAY

MCP Gateway

Unified MCP Server entry point with centralized policy, routing, and audit

ZERO TRUST

Zero Trust

Deny all operations by default. No implicit trust. Every tool call must pass security checks

LEASE FLOW

Zero Exposure: From Storage to Destruction

Real secrets never enter model context. Safely injected at execution moment, burned after use

Secret Store

OS Keychain

Real credentials stored in system keychain. Vigils only holds reference aliases.

Lease Mint

5min TTL

Issue short-term lease for this operation, bound to scope and 300s TTL.

Firewall Check

Policy Match

Triple detection passed: deterministic parsing → policy matching → risk scoring.

Sandbox

env_clear

Credentials injected via environment variable into Wasmtime sandbox, least-privilege execution.

Auto Revoke

Post-exec

Lease revoked immediately after operation. In-process cache cleared. Zero credential residue.

Secret Store→secret://github/read-only→[REDACTED]

Agent and model context always see only secret://github/read-only or [REDACTED github_token]. Real values are cached in-process by lease system and injected. Audit chain records only alias, never value.

USE CASES

Who Uses Vigils

Different roles, same trust

Individual AI Developer

Pain

When coding with Claude Code / Cursor, accidentally pasting API keys into the chat window leads to credential leaks

Solution

Chrome extension intercepts paste events in real-time. Blocks immediately on hard fingerprints like github_token / aws_access_key, zero cloud reporting

Paste Guard

Enterprise Security Team

Pain

Teams use AI Agent tools for business code, needing audit records for all tool calls and mandatory approval for sensitive operations

Solution

Local MCP Hub + SHA256 audit chain. Every tool call generates an immutable DecisionRecord. High-risk operations automatically enter the approval queue

Audit Chain

Red Team / Internal Audit

Pain

Need to verify AI Agents cannot bypass security policies to execute dangerous operations

Solution

Built-in red-team test scenarios covering prompt injection, tool descriptor tampering, secret leakage, and more. All test cases enforced in CI
